posts.author: Ayush_Singh
posts.text: From my perspective, Definitely yes. They took rmg, esports, ad-tech, offline etc. They are related but are vastly different models and require different strategies. Would have preferred a more focused strategy around gaming studios, IP and publishing. Though I am huge believer of its potential as a company but I am not happy with the execution . Also i don’t like the management overhead they have . It look like for anything they acquire they keep everyone including ceo. It may look good on paper that they would be more focused but it would definitely become " too many cooks can spoil the meal…
